correctness.rationale: Exact rank of a connected signed incidence matrix follows from its one-dimensional possible left nullspace along a spanning tree and sign consistency; pseudoforest formula is exact for all q,k. Independent edge hashes yield independent Poisson limits of fixed cycle lengths with lambda_l=c^(2l)/(2l); the uniform subcritical cycle tail and absence of complex components yield total Poisson mean -log(1-c²)/2. Exponential PGF gives (1-c²)^1/4. For c>=1, balanced short cycles provide upper bound tending to zero. Eight exhaustive rational rank enumerations and five numerical samples passed when checker rerun. The critical result does not rely on simulations.

value.rationale: The exact probability of rank preservation for an important sparse-sketch family on its most coherent fixed subspace is an operational natural reliability invariant. It reveals a c=1 full-rank survival threshold and nontrivial losses for any fixed 0<c<1, yields a numerical necessary oversampling threshold for 95% rank success, and provides exact finite component probabilities usable as verification oracles. Rank failure cannot be inferred from prior vanishing smallest-positive-singular-value results. This is not just a parameter renaming or a single-pair collision estimate.
